title: Episodes 102-103 — The Competitive Ledger interviews Adrian Vale
locator: Episode 102, "O Dinheiro Não Joga" (2027-01-14); Episode 103, "O Que o Dinheiro Não Compra" (2027-01-15)
notes: Nathaniel Price, editor-in-chief of the fictional outlet The Competitive Ledger, interviews Adrian Vale on 2027-01-14 at the Kairos campus.
Episode 103 confirms the resulting article published the morning of 2027-01-15 under the title 'Adrian Vale Doesn't Think Money Can Buy a Championship. He's Spending Millions to Find Out.'

Adrian shows Nathaniel partial financial-structure documentation with individual contract values and client identities redacted; this is represented in the Kairospedia publication as Adrian's own dated interview statements, not as a change to Asterion Intelligence's canon financial fields, which remain TBD.
